subject: Error on Simple Linear Regression Model

messages.author: 436b901c200ff2b9
messages.subject: Error on Simple Linear Regression Model
parts:
Hi 

I'm getting the following error message when running a simple linear regression.
Warning messages: running command '"./R/win-library/3.1/INLA/bin/windows/inla64.exe"  -b -s -v  "./AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpkj26P4/file1dd012855e8b/Model.ini"' had status 3 

  • Data: MASS package - birthwt 
  • Replicated error on 2 Window's 7 PCs and a Mac.
  • Tried running with "verbose = T" but I can't identify the issue. 
  • Tried changing the variables from integer to numeric
  • Running on a different dataset such as iris works. 
  • The same code (without "verbose = T") using glm works
  • The issue is also present in more complex version of the formula

Code:
library(MASS)
library(INLA)
mod_inla  <- inla(bwt ~ 1 + lwt, data = birthwt, family = 'gaussian', verbose = T)
summary(mod_inla)

Many thanks

Chris

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error on Simple Linear Regression Model
parts:
Hi,

It is due to the fact that the outcome has huge (1e3 to 5e3) values and
the initial value for the Gaussian precision causes numeric problems. It
works with smaller initial value for the precision, for example, it
works for exp(0):

On Thursday, June 25, 2015 at 2:29:13 PM UTC+1, Elias T. Krainski wrote:
Hi,

It is due to the fact that the outcome has huge (1e3 to 5e3) values and
the initial value for the Gaussian precision causes numeric problems. It
works with smaller initial value for the precision, for example, it
works for exp(0):

mod_inla  <- inla(bwt ~ 1 + lwt, data = birthwt, family = 'gaussian',
control.family=list(initial=0))

Elias
